metadata.comparisonRule: Exact ordered parity: speaker IDs are stored separately in segment order; each expectedSegments row is the raw Float32 [startTimeSeconds,endTimeSeconds,qualityScore] bit pattern encoded by the existing little-endian tensor helper; input speakerWeights are Float32 bit patterns and chunkOffsets are Float64 bit patterns. sampleCount is metadata only and does not participate in reconstruction or EOF clipping. All golden cases have unique start times across different speaker IDs. A diagnostic run with minSegmentDurationSeconds=0 and exclusiveSegments=false rejects equal-start cases before any golden is written; such dictionary/set-order cases are excluded because FluidAudio does not define cross-speaker ordering for equal starts.
metadata.inputConstruction: Golden outputs come directly from FluidAudio 0.15.8 OfflineReconstruction (OfflineReconstruction.swift:24-29,69-103,145-174,187-237,359-495). Each case supplies SegmentationOutput.logProbs=[], binary Float32 speakerWeights, explicit chunkOffsets and frameDuration, hardClusters, and three local speakers. centroids is a fixed array of clusterCount copies of [0.0] only because buildSegments derives its cluster count and attaches embeddings; embeddings are not part of this oracle output. spanEmbedder is nil. sampleCount is fixture metadata only: buildSegments accepts neither sampleCount nor clip EOF, so the final-padded-past-eof case intentionally preserves its overrun.
